system.description:
You launch the thrown weapons into the sky before your weapons collide bouncing off of each other as they rain downward in a cascade of dangerous steel. Select a point you can see within range. All creatures in a 15-foot radius centered on this point must make Constitution Saving throw to weather the rain of steel. On a failure they take your [Weapon Damage] + 1d6 and gain 1 rank of Bleed. On a success they take half damage and suffer no effects.

Chain 1: Creatures who fail their saving throw are grappled in place until the end of their next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d6.
